# اُسْتُحْفِظُوا (ustuḥfiẓū) /us.tuħ.fi.ðˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْفَظَ (istaḥfaẓa)
# اِسْتَحْفِظُوا (istaḥfiẓū) /is.taħ.fi.ðˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْفَظَ (istaḥfaẓa)
